title: Will and Testament Application

signers.label: Approving Justice
signers.note: Filled automatically at approval — not part of the intake handoff flow.

notes: Source Google Doc had leftover example data ('Blaine Walker', 'Juliet Wolf') from a test fill rather than a pristine blank — those were replaced with proper {{key}} fields. Asset list is modeled as one free-form multi-line field rather than a fixed 10-row table, since a bot-driven intake should let the applicant list as many assets as they have.

fields.label: Applicant Discordia
fields.prompt: What Discord email/account do you have on file?

fields.label: Marital Status
fields.prompt: Are you married or not married?

fields.label: Fallback Power of Attorney
fields.prompt: If you are not married, who should receive power of attorney over your estate?
fields.note: Only relevant if is_married is "Not Married".

fields.label: Asset List
fields.prompt: List your assets and who should receive each one, one per line (Asset — Recipient name and SSN).

fields.label: Approving Justice
fields.note: Rendered in cursive. Filled in by the bot when a Justice approves the will — never asked of the applicant.
